note: Hand-researched opening lines, one per contact id, overriding the derived opener in influencer-db.mjs. The derived openers are true but generic by construction: they say how the contact was found, not anything about the contact. These say something only true of that person, which is the difference between a cold email that reads as researched and one that reads as a merge. `basis` records what each claim was verified from so the assertion can be audited rather than trusted. An entry with opener:null is a deliberate decision to fall back to the derived opener, not an oversight; --check requires every P1 contact to have an entry either way.
